cards.subject: The hole Thaurissan tore
lines: Losing his civil war, the Dark Iron sorcerer-thane cast a spell to summon a champion. It worked. It tore through into the Firelands and pulled Ragnaros into the world, and the eruption shattered the mountains.
The burning lake underneath you is not a lake. It is that tear, still open. Everything in the room walked out of it, including the landlord.

cards.subject: The attunement was never a gate
lines: Anybody who walked the whole way through Blackrock Depths could step into the Core without it.
What the quest bought was a teleport, and the wiki says so outright: "not a true attunement... but a quest to enable a shortcut."

cards.subject: There was no summoning stone
lines: In 1.12 the stone outside is a group-finder object and summons nobody.
So there was exactly one way to spare the other thirty-nine the run through the mountain.
A warlock, two clickers, and a chain built one body at a time.

cards.subject: Seven fires have to go out first
lines: Kress, Mohn, Blaz, Zeth, Mazj, Koro, Theri — one beside each boss but the first.
Every one had to be doused before Majordomo would appear at all.
He is not a boss you walk up to. He is a boss you unlock.

cards.subject: Somebody had to go to Azshara every week
lines: The douser was consumed on use, one rune each, and Duke Hydraxis handed them out on the other side of the world.
That trip happened every single reset.
Patch 1.11 finally made it reusable, behind Revered. For the raid's first year it was not.

cards.subject: The dogs get back up
lines: A hound returns at full health if it has been dead more than ten seconds and any packmate is still alive.
Every hound in the pack has to fall inside the same ten-second window or the pull restarts itself.
Forty people, one clock.

cards.subject: Majordomo does not die
cards.tag: You beat him until he quits
lines: Kill his eight servants and Executus becomes unkillable and yields: "Impossible! Stay your attack, mortal... I submit! I submit!"
He drops nothing. He walks away and leaves a cache behind him.
"I go now to summon the lord whose house this is."

cards.subject: He is angry at the wrong person
lines: "TOO SOON! YOU HAVE AWAKENED ME TOO SOON, EXECUTUS! WHAT IS THE MEANING OF THIS INTRUSION???"
Then he executes his own majordomo in front of the raid.
"NOW FOR YOU, INSECTS!"

cards.subject: It picks the people with mana
lines: The knockback only targets players who have a mana bar, and throws them about twenty yards from the point of impact.
Into lava, if you stood badly.
"BY FIRE BE PURGED!"

cards.subject: Three minutes in, he leaves
lines: He submerges into the lake and is immune for about ninety seconds. Eight Sons of Flame come up in his place.
They burn, and they carry a mana-burn aura.
The phase that takes your target away also drains the people who have to live through it.

cards.subject: Two halves, two bosses, one desert
lines: Left off Baron Geddon, right off Garr. They are why people kept running a farmed raid long after the gear stopped mattering.
Both are needed, and neither is the end of it.
Thunderfury starts in this room and is finished in Silithus.

cards.subject: The eye is not a weapon
lines: The Eye of Sulfuras drops off Ragnaros himself, and it is only the component.
The other half is made by a three-hundred blacksmith, from plans traded for an ingot off another boss in here.
The first legendary in the game needed a raid, a profession and a merchant.

cards.subject: The first forty
lines: The first Ragnaros kill in the world went to a guild on the same realm that would later be first through the gates of Ahn'Qiraj.
For everyone else this room was simply the first time forty people they knew had ever been in one place with one job.
